newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - DUTCH MADGE NETWORKS UP.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - DUTCH MADGE NETWORKS UP.

text.p: Dutch computer network company Madge Networks Inc was slightly higher in active trade following news that it had reached a deal with U.S. Sun Microsystems Inc, dealers said Monday.
"It's a definite positive for the company," said one dealer.
Madge's American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) were trading 15/16 higher at 7.
Under the terms of the deal, Sun Microsystems will sell an adapter that Madge designed.
European ADRs were otherwise quiet, the trader said.

Imperial Chemical Industries Plc was 11/16 up at 70-1/4 despite a ratings cut by Salomon Brothers to hold from buy. British Petroleum Co Plc was 11/16 higher at 85-5/8, while Royal Dutch Petroleum Co was also higher, up 9/16 at 54-1/4.
Although trade in Latin American ADRs was also calm, prices were mostly lower.
"It's summer," said another dealer. "There's nothing to it."
Mexico's Telefonos de Mexico was 13/16 down at 53 and Telebras SA of Brazil was 1-1/8 lower at 136-1/2.
Some Canadian stocks were trading on higher volumes than usual, including Thermo Tech Technologies Inc, which was 9/32 down at 2-3/4.
Decliners led advancers 308 to 193 among 814 ADRs.
The ADR group was down 0.39 percent on a lower than usual volume of 28.9 million ADRs.
ADRs enable U.S. trade in foreign stock.
